# Visual investigation recipe

A cold investigation desk. Grey footage, photographs and typeset documents from one real event share a single clock, so they check each other. The clock sits inside the picture: timestamps on message cards, a red playhead on a chart. Frames are frozen and circled; quotes are highlighted on the page they came from; at the end every source points at one place on a plan. Near-black ground, hairline frames, one signal colour that only ever points.

## Rules of the desk
1. Meet at a moment. A section ends when two or more independent sources (a frame, a photo, a message, a technician's note) land on the same place or the same second.
2. One clock, inside the picture. Time is a readout owned by the layout: a counter in a tag row, a card timestamp, a playhead with its clock on a chart. No permanent timeline band under every shot.
3. One finding per layout. A heading belongs to its layout; no page header.
4. Draw the doubt. Use `≈`, *skematik*, dashed cones. A source that does not exist yet is not on screen yet. Never show an empty "no footage" box.
5. Stay calm. No music beats, no slow motion, no drama: counted facts and quiet type.

Not this: newsreel (no channel bug, ticker or anchor); stage talk (no centred title slides, no page turns); collage (no stamps, tape or print texture).

## Surfaces
Footage and photos:
- Always greyscale, one grade: `filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.22) brightness(0.94)`, so contrast 1.22 and brightness 0.94.
- Dark vignette, plus one film grain layered with `overlay` at about 22-24 %, shifted every 0.1 s. Grain touches pictures only, never type or lines.
- Same 1 px frame on each.
- The example paints three stand-in shots (alley, drain, gate camera). The user's own media from `list_media` replaces them with the identical grade and grain.

Documents and messages:
- Typeset by code on a paper-coloured card in typewriter mono, labelled with author and time. Never a redrawn scan.
- Highlight only the decisive line: signal colour at about 60 %, wiped left to right.

Drawn evidence (plan, chart): thin linework on the second surface. Dashed where inferred; label *skematik* where not measured.

Panels: hard-edged rectangles, 1 px frame. Footage keeps its source aspect (cover crop, never stretched).

## Palette
- Ground: `--latar` (default `#0b0c0e`)
- Panels (denah, grafik): `--latar-2`
- Hairlines and ticks: `--garis`, `--tanda`, mixed from `--teks`
- Text: `--teks`; secondary `--teks-redup`
- Signal colour, meaning here / now / match: `--utama` for circles, links, playhead, bars, badges, pills; `--utama-di-latar` for words and lines over the ground
- Paper cards: `--aksen`, ink `--teks-di-aksen`
- Fixed, not brand: footage greys `--film-1…4`, white flash `--kilat`

Sources stay grey in every brand. The signal colour only points: circles, leaders, sync lines, playhead, peak bars, ticked badges, the highlighted line, the contact pill.

## Type
- `--font-judul`: Space Grotesk 700. Headlines 92-104 px; lower-third name 48 px; chart and plan headings 46 px; ring labels 22 px with a dark halo. Tracking -0.01 em.
- `--font-isi`: IBM Plex Mono 400/600. Tags and timestamps 20-24 px at 0.06 em tracking; message quotes 28 px; document text 26-30 px, leading 1.5. Another brand font works if there is room, since mono runs wide.
- Few words per frame: the main readout or heading, the highlighted original, one short source tag per piece of evidence.
- Tag placement: just above its frame, a 6x12 chip plus `JENIS · SUMBER, JAM`.

## Motion
- Elements cut in; they never fly. Opacity jumps, and a white flash of 0.13-0.14 s (opacity 0.9 to 0, linear) fires on scene cuts and on each new card.
- Only drawn things build up progressively:
  - circles: clockwise, 0.5 s, `power3.out`
  - dashed links: 0.45 s, `power2.out`
  - highlight wipe: 0.7-0.8 s, `power1.inOut`
  - chart bars: grow as the playhead passes
- Playhead: eases between keyframes (`power2.inOut`, 0.25-0.45 s). Counters: constant speed.
- Inside a frame, push slowly: at most 1.05x for the hook, 1.03x for the ending. The camera itself never moves. Badges land 0.12 s apart, from 1.35x scale.
- Something changes at least every 0.6 s until the verdict. The ending holds still 2 s or more.

## Cuts and camera
- Hard cut with flash: new evidence pulled from the locker. Every scene change, each new card.
- Circle drawn, leader, label: "look here". Any frame that holds the answer.
- Dashed link to a close-up: the same spot, closer. Hooks, facts.
- Playhead sweep: time passing across data. Complaints, sales, traffic, views.
- Converging links: independent sources agreeing. Proofs, verdicts.
- Push inside the picture (up to 1.05x): attention settling. Openings, endings.

## Signature moves
- Freeze, circle, magnify. Flash, circle drawn clockwise, a leader and a bold label at 60 %, then a second frame of the same spot closer, joined by a dashed link. Fits: a leaking pipe in a market, a typo on a school notice, a sold-out shelf, a crack in pottery glaze.
- Messages on the clock. Typeset cards land on flashes at their timestamps while a red playhead moves along a chart and pins drop on the axis. Fits: neighbours' chat logs, customer complaints before a refund policy, a creator's comments before a video, student questions before a lesson.
- Highlighted original. The decisive line of a typed note is wiped in signal colour on its own page. Fits: a village head's memo, a recipe card, a rule in a club handbook, a quote in a letter.
- Evidence converges. Three circled sources send dashed links to one ringed zone on a schematic plan; ticked badges land one by one. Fits: where a smell starts, which stall a queue forms at, which room a draught enters, why a route runs late.
- Finding, held. One headline, one lower third with a red bar, one contact pill, the photo breathing 3 %. Fits: a fact-check, a local-news explainer, a repair shop's diagnosis, a class's "what we found".

## Avoid
- Inference shown as fact. Camera angles and times need `≈`, a dashed outline or *skematik* on screen.
- Overload: one layout, one finding, five sources at most; never echo the headline in a caption.
- Empty placeholder boxes. Fill the slot, or let the source appear when it starts.
- A bottom strip reserved for a timeline or captions and left empty.
- Colour on sources. Footage stays grey; the signal colour never fills a photo.
- Clipped text in cards or tags. Size boxes to their text; shorten quotes to about 45 characters per line at 28 px mono.
- Catastrophe as spectacle, or naming a real person or business as guilty. Use invented or consenting subjects and state what is unknown.

# Visual investigation: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.4, medium 2.4, long 3.6.

## hook

- en: a frozen frame with a red circle drawn clockwise, a dashed link to a close-up, the quote highlighted on its page, a clock running
- id: frame beku dengan lingkaran merah searah jarum jam, garis putus ke bidikan dekat, kutipan disorot di halamannya, jam berjalan

## problem

- en: typeset message cards cut in on white flashes at their timestamps while a red playhead sweeps a chart and bars rise behind it
- id: kartu pesan diketik muncul dengan kilat putih pada jamnya, kursor merah menyapu grafik dan batang naik di belakangnya

## fact

- en: one source frame circled and magnified beside the document line that names it, both tagged with source and time
- id: satu frame sumber dilingkari dan dibesarkan di samping baris dokumen yang menyebutnya, keduanya diberi tag sumber dan jam

## step

- en: one step per layout, cut on a hard flash: the evidence for that step, its tag and a circle, never a dissolve
- id: satu langkah per layout, dipotong keras dengan kilat: bukti langkah itu, tagnya, dan satu lingkaran, tanpa dissolve

## compare

- en: two evidence frames side by side with a red dashed line across them at the same instant; the odd one is struck through
- id: dua frame bukti berdampingan dengan garis putus merah melintang pada detik yang sama; yang keliru dicoret

## number

- en: one big readout in the headline face, held alone on the dark ground with a small mono source tag and a red bar
- id: satu angka besar dengan font judul, ditahan sendirian di latar gelap dengan tag sumber mono kecil dan batang merah

## proof

- en: three sources circled, red dashed links converge on one zone of a schematic plan, ticked badges land 0.12 s apart
- id: tiga sumber dilingkari, garis putus merah bertemu di satu titik denah skematik, lencana centang mendarat berselang 0,12 detik

## offer

- en: the conclusion as a solid red pill beside the evidence photo, cut in after the finding line
- id: kesimpulan sebagai pil merah solid di samping foto bukti, muncul setelah baris temuan

## cta

- en: the finding and one contact pill held still beside the circled photo; only the picture breathes (3%)
- id: temuan dan satu pil kontak ditahan diam di samping foto yang dilingkari; hanya gambar yang bernapas (3%)

## payoff

- en: the finding in one layout: circled photo, lower third with a red bar, headline and contact pill, held still for 2 s
- id: temuan dalam satu layout: foto dilingkari, lower third bergaris merah, judul dan pil kontak, ditahan diam 2 detik

      function canvas() {
        const c = document.createElement("canvas");

      function poly(g, pts, fill, a = 1) {
        g.globalAlpha = a;
        g.fillStyle = fill;
        g.beginPath();
        pts.forEach(([x, y], i) => (i ? g.lineTo(x, y) : g.moveTo(x, y)));

      function ground(g, top, bottom) {
        const l = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);

        l.addColorStop(1, bottom);
